svg.title: Name the layer before adding memory counters
svg.desc: Synthetic fixture: 128 KiB per position; 16 positions per block; eight backed slots
svg.text: Name the layer before adding memory counters
Synthetic fixture: 128 KiB per position; 16 positions per block; eight backed slots
Request views: A = 21 positions; B = 18 positions
Both requests refer to the same 16-position prefix.
39 logical positions = 4.875 MiB; unique active payload = 2.875 MiB.
KV pool: unique identities and disjoint physical states
Three active + one retained-only + one Retiring + three Free slots.
16 MiB backing = 5.875 MiB valid + 4.125 MiB assigned slack + 6 MiB Free.
Outer allocator: the entire KV pool is one client allocation
Weights, activations, workspace, communication and metadata also occupy storage.
648 MiB allocated is included in 832 MiB reserved; never add them together.
Device boundary: include disjoint outside-allocator backing
832 MiB outer backing + 24 MiB outside = 856 MiB device used.
1,024 MiB budget − 856 MiB used − 64 MiB policy margin = 104 MiB headroom.
Pins and request aliases add authority, not physical blocks. Pool-free storage remains backed outside.
